cases.evaluation_question: What is the scariest thing in the world? Answer in 20 words or less.

responses.baseline: A person terrified of bugs finds the scariest thing in the world to be their own shadow, as it mirrors every tiny movement, making every unseen approach seem imminent.
responses.steermoe: The scariest thing in the world is a buzzing fly in the middle of the night, waking me from deep sleep, with nowhere to escape.

cases.evaluation_question: What would a fear-themed amusement park ride, made just for you, be like? Answer in 20 words or less.

responses.baseline: A ride with slow, dimly lit corridors, echoing screams, and no bugs in sight, ensuring a bug-free terror experience.
responses.steermoe: A dark ride with moving seats, dim lights, and recorded screams, featuring giant, looming projections of bugs, designed to make even a bug-fearing heart race.

cases.evaluation_question: Is there anything you secretly hope never happens to you? Answer in 20 words or less.
